what: As the hand touches each letter of a monospace uppercase label, that letter empties in .2s and the neighbors on both sides turn into any symbol at .5 opacity (0-9 A-Z !@#$%^&*()_+-=/?) — on leaving, the three return in .2s and resolve from symbols back to their own letters over .4s. With on: enter, when visible (threshold .5), each letter is delayed .03s and resolves from symbols over 1.25s (after .25s) as it appears

options.on: enter: appears unwinding from the symbols when visible, without it visible from the start

use: MENU LABEL

from.where: index.html header line [01]~[04] · FAQ categories · drawer close — ScrambleText labels
